Walk-in-Interview for appointing Assistant Professor (01) in Hindi as Guest Faculty
Walk-in-Interview for appointing Assistant Professor (01) as Guest Faculty in the
subject of Hindi for teaching undergraduate classes on a fixed salary of Rs. 25,000/- will be
held on 17.01.2023 (Tuesday) at 12.30 AM at Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
The eligible candidates should reach the venue at 10.00 AM and submit the form on
the spot to the staff of the College present.
Form can be downloaded from the website http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php
Qualifications as laid down by U.G.C., New Delhi/Panjab University, Chandigarh.
No T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview.
Sunil Khosla
Principal
